name: Early-onset autosomal recessive TTN-related distal myopathy
aliases: TTN-related distal myopathy, early-onset autosomal recessive

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Proposed diagnostic criteria for TTN-related distal myopathy

criteria.description: Progressive distal muscle weakness with onset in childhood or adolescence
Biallelic pathogenic variants in the TTN gene confirmed by molecular genetic testing
Muscle biopsy showing myopathic changes with characteristic titin-related pathology
Electromyography demonstrating myopathic motor unit potentials

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of progressive distal muscle weakness with onset in childhood or adolescence plus biallelic pathogenic TTN variants
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Muscle biopsy and electromyography findings support diagnosis but are not mandatory if genetic confirmation is obtained.

searchTerms: foot weakness starting early in life
early onset foot drop causing walking problems
weakness in small hand muscles over time
mild muscle weakness near body center
muscle wasting in hands and feet
shrinking muscles in arms and legs

common.symptomName: Gait disturbance due to distal weakness
searchTerms: difficulty walking due to weak legs

common.symptomName: Elevated serum creatine kinase levels (mild to moderate)
common.notes: Typically less than 5 times upper limit of normal
searchTerms: mildly to moderately high muscle enzyme levels

occasional.symptomName: Respiratory muscle involvement with mild dyspnea
searchTerms: breathing muscle weakness causing mild shortness of breath
difficulty breathing due to weak respiratory muscles

rare.symptomName: Dysphagia due to oropharyngeal muscle weakness
searchTerms: difficulty swallowing from throat muscle weakness
trouble swallowing due to muscle problems

laboratory: Mild to moderate elevation of serum creatine kinase
Normal or mildly elevated lactate dehydrogenase
imaging: Muscle MRI showing selective involvement of distal leg muscles with fatty replacement
Echocardiogram may reveal conduction defects or mild cardiomyopathy
other: Muscle biopsy demonstrating myopathic changes with fiber size variability, internal nuclei, and occasional rimmed vacuoles

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of rimmed vacuoles on muscle biopsy
TTN-related but with predominant proximal muscle weakness
Later onset compared to early-onset distal myopathy
Different mutation spectrum in TTN gene

redFlags: Rapid progression of muscle weakness over weeks
references: Hackman P, et al. Early-onset recessive distal titinopathy. Neurology. 2008;71(24):2130-2137.
